While their All Things Possible Ministries did purchase five Fold AR weapon systems for Lindale High School in Texas, no further participation from their ministries was ever made or offered without explanation.

verification.notes: Hall later stated publicly that All Things Possible Ministries funded five FoldAR systems for a local school and that after summer 2024 the ministry made no further school-resource-officer effort. This is a firsthand account and is consistent with the publicly promoted school mission, though no independent invoice was located.
